title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(廣瀬康夫研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Hirose Yasuo)
keywords: Aeronautics 2.Aircraft conceptual design, Aircraft planning 3.Advanced structural concept 4.Damage tolerance 5.Regional alliance
educationalGoal: The basic ability to design, fabricate and propose feasible ideas on transportation machines by applying aeronautical engineering theory will be obtained. In addition, students feed a viewpoint to evaluate the application effect of the new technologies such as innovative structure concepts by an interest loss and gain of the transportation machines such as aircraft.
advice: Course Description and Expectations for Students The department of aeronautics aims to develop engineers who can support the development of transportation machines such as aircraft using their knowledge of aeronautics, machine design, and production technology of transportation machines. Design Project III is the subject of the collected studies in the final stage of the curriculum. The targets of this subject are the following: -to develop the abilities of design and analysis through the designing of actual transport machines such as aircraft, applying theories of mainly aeronautics, and evaluating actual phenomena relating to the transportation machines such as aircraft. -to develop the ability to estimate the obtained results from the aeronautical engineering viewpoint. -to carry out research on the problem in order to fabricate integral structures to realize the full potential capabilities of composite materials. A detailed project theme is decided through discussion with the teacher. Students will discover their own problems and solve them. Students must also understand the targets of this subject, and an overview of the content of the course and the objectives based on the syllabus. In particular, students must understand which part of the learning objectives of this department this subject carries and a detailed level of the achievement.
requiredKnowledge: Because Design Project III is based on lectures, experiments, and practice of quarters 1-6 in the department of aeronautics, students must review them appropriately as needed.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Students clearly understand the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose. (2)Students prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present and discuss it.Students prepare their research result as a final report and make a presentation and discuss it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting. (3)For problems on aircraft structure design, students make full use of design tools such as 3D-CAD and structural analysis software and can realize a solution.
achievementLevels.standard: (1)Students clearly understand the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose. (2)Students should prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present it. Students prepare the final result as a final report and present it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting. (3)For problems on aircraft structure design, students can examine a solution using design tools such as 3D-CAD and the structural analysis software with instruction.

lessons.operation: Introduction to the research activities in the laboratory by the teacher.

lessons.content: Students conduct structural concept design of an aircraft and research composite structural elements. Students evaluate their research results to contribute to the enhancement of weight reduction and damage tolerance.
lessons.assignments: Paper. Report and document search on the reference book relation to their major subject.
